tipo.title: Result type
tipo.description: Return individual job postings or enriched company records keyed by ATS + company_slug.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as IT, DE, or US. Comma-separated values are ORed. Leave empty for worldwide. In company mode, filters the country on the company record.

category.title: Job category (jobs only)
category.description: Job-family category. Comma-separated values are ORed.

ats.title: ATS platform (jobs only)
ats.description: Source platform slug such as workday, greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters, icims, or successfactors. Comma-separated values are ORed.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Jobs: exact match against normalized technologies extracted from the posting. Companies: match against the company-level technology aggregate. Comma-separated values are ORed.

q.title: Keyword
q.description: Jobs: all terms must match the title or description. Companies: case-insensitive company-name search.

seniority.title: Seniority (jobs only)
seniority.description: Filter by classified seniority. Empty includes all values.

remote.title: Workplace (jobs only)
remote.description: Filter by classified workplace. Empty includes all values.

language.title: Language (jobs only)
language.description: ISO language code such as en, de, or it. Comma-separated values are ORed.

dal.title: Posted after (jobs only)
dal.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, for example 2026-11-01. Posting dates can be estimated when the source does not expose an exact date.

industry.title: Industry (companies only)
industry.description: Exact industry value on the company record.

employees_min.title: Minimum employees (companies only)
employees_min.description: Lower bound on the company employee count.

employees_max.title: Maximum employees (companies only)
employees_max.description: Upper bound on the company employee count.

limite.title: Maximum results
limite.description: Maximum number of rows returned by this run, from 1 to 5,000.
